enrichment.jsDocDescription: A page-level layout component that renders either a Footer or Header variant, providing structural framing for page content within the NU Design System.
enrichment.notes: This component has two variants: Footer and Header. The root tag should adapt per variant — 'footer' for Footer and 'header' for Header. Since only one tag can be specified, 'footer' is chosen as the primary. The image element (e1) is likely a logo or decorative asset. Text elements suggest this is a branding/navigation footer or header. Consider using <header> with role='banner' for the Header variant.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A small badge component used to display a token label, optionally with a color indicator. Typically used inline to represent categorized or tagged items.
enrichment.notes: The component renders a label text and an optional color shape. A `span` is appropriate as this is an inline decorative/informational badge. If used interactively (e.g., removable), consider wrapping in a button or adding role and keyboard support.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A color swatch component that displays a color sample along with its name and hex code. Optionally shows a base color indicator marker.
enrichment.notes: The root should use role='img' with an aria-label describing the color (e.g. 'Color swatch: 100, #FFFFFF') so screen readers can convey the visual color information. The Base Color Indicator is a conditional shape that marks a swatch as the base/reference color.

A versatile button component supporting multiple hierarchy levels (Primary, Secondary, Tertiary), interaction states (Default, Hover, Pressed, Disabled, Focused), and display types (Default, Inverted). Used to trigger actions or submit forms.
enrichment.notes: Use the native <button> element for accessibility. Set aria-disabled=true and prevent click handlers when State is 'Disabled'. The 'Inverted' type is typically used on dark backgrounds. Hierarchy maps to visual styling only and does not affect semantics.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A link button component that renders as an anchor element, supporting optional left and right icons alongside a text label. Adapts to Large/Small sizes and Desktop/Mobile device contexts.
enrichment.notes: Despite the name 'Link_Button_Master', the presence of a 'Link Value' text property and the semantic intent of navigation strongly suggest an anchor tag. If used purely for triggering actions without navigation, consider switching to a button element. The optional icons should have aria-hidden=true to avoid redundant screen reader output.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A link styled as a button, supporting primary and secondary hierarchy variants, default and inverted types, and interactive states including hover, pressed, disabled, and focused. Use when navigation is required but a button appearance is desired.
enrichment.notes: Despite the button-like appearance, this component represents a navigational link (anchor tag). Ensure an href is always provided. When the Disabled state is active, use aria-disabled='true' and prevent default navigation behavior via JavaScript, since anchor tags do not natively support the disabled attribute.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A radio button input component used for selecting a single option from a group. Supports multiple visual states including default, hover, active, focused, and disabled variants.
enrichment.notes: This component should always be used within a fieldset/radiogroup context. The 'type' attribute should be set to 'radio'. Disabled states map to the HTML 'disabled' attribute. Consider pairing with a label element for accessibility.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A radio button group presenting a question with multiple selectable options. Supports Mobile and Desktop layout variants.
enrichment.notes: The root should be a fieldset with a legend for the question text. Each Option container maps to a label wrapping a radio input and its text. The Options container is a list of radio choices.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A checkbox input component that allows users to select or deselect an option. Supports unchecked, checked, intermediate, hover, pressed, focused, and disabled states.
enrichment.notes: Use with an associated label element for accessibility. The intermediate state should set aria-checked to 'mixed'. Disabled variants should set aria-disabled to true. The root should render as <input type="checkbox"> in implementation.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A checkbox option group presenting a question with multiple selectable options. Supports Desktop and Mobile variants, rendering a list of labeled checkbox inputs for multi-select form interactions.
enrichment.notes: The root is a fieldset grouping related checkboxes under a shared question label. The question text (e1) should be a legend element (not in allowed set, so mapped to h3 as closest semantic). Each Option container is a labeled checkbox row. The Options container (e2) is a ul since it holds repeated Option items.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A chevron navigation control used to indicate directional navigation (left or right). Supports multiple interaction states including default, hover, pressed, and focused.
enrichment.notes: The aria-label should be dynamically set based on the Direction variant, e.g. 'Navigate left' or 'Navigate right'. This component is typically used in carousels, sliders, or paginated content. The icon-only nature of the button makes an explicit aria-label essential for accessibility.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Switches are the preferred way to adjust settings. They're used to control binary options – think On/Off or True/False.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A toggle switch component that represents an on/off state. Renders as a track with a sliding handle knob, supporting enabled, disabled, and focused states.
enrichment.notes: Should be implemented as an input[type=checkbox] with role='switch' for proper accessibility. The 'Selected' variant maps to the checked state, and the 'Disabled' state should set aria-disabled and the disabled attribute. The visual handle/knob is purely decorative.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A video playback control button that supports multiple states (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focused) and control types (Play, Pause, Forward, Rewind). Renders an icon representing the current control action.
enrichment.notes: The aria-label should be dynamically set based on the 'Type' variant (e.g., 'Play', 'Pause', 'Rewind', 'Forward'). The focused state appears to use a wrapper container, likely for a visible focus ring. Consider using aria-pressed for toggle states like Play/Pause.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A chip component that represents a compact, interactive element used for filtering, selection, or input. Supports optional left and right icons, multiple sizes, and various interaction states including hover, disabled, selected, and focused.
enrichment.notes: Use role='option' or aria-pressed depending on context: if used for filtering/selection, aria-pressed (toggle button) is appropriate. If used within a listbox for selection, role='option' may be better. The 'Selected' variant should set aria-pressed=true. The 'Disabled' variant should set aria-disabled=true. Consider wrapping multiple chips in a ul/li structure at the parent level.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A tag/badge component that displays a text label with an optional icon. Supports multiple color variants (RoyalBlue, Wheat, Fuchsia, Avocado) and two sizes (Large, Small), used to categorize or label content.
A text input atom that supports both placeholder and secure (password) text states, representing the base input field used across web forms.
enrichment.notes: The 'Placeholder' variant represents a standard text input, while the 'Secure' variant maps to a password input (type='password'). The cursor element confirms this is an interactive input field. Consider using type='text' or type='password' depending on the variant.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A desktop text field component that supports multiple interaction states (Default, Hover, Active, Filled, Success, Warning, Error, Locked, Disabled, Focused). Wraps a label, input, and optional helper/validation message for form data entry.
enrichment.notes: The root should be a div wrapping a label element and an input element. Use aria-disabled=true when State is Disabled or Locked. For Error/Warning/Success states, pair with aria-describedby pointing to a helper message element. The actual interactive control inside should be an <input> with appropriate type attribute.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A text field component for entering a country code, supporting multiple visual states such as default, hover, active, filled, success, warning, error, locked, disabled, and focused. Typically used within forms requiring country or phone prefix selection.
enrichment.notes: Although this is a text field, the root is best represented as a div wrapper since it likely composes a label, input, and optional message/icon elements. The actual input inside should use the input tag with appropriate type attribute (e.g., type='text'). Consider aria-invalid for error/warning states and aria-disabled for the disabled/locked states.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A mobile text field component with label, placeholder, helper text, and character count. Supports multiple states including Default, Hover, Active, Filled, Success, Warning, and Error.
enrichment.notes: This is a form field wrapper containing a label, input area, helper text, and character counter. The actual interactive input element is implied by the text area and cursor elements. Consider using a native <input> or <textarea> inside this wrapper for accessibility.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A master text field component for desktop that includes an optional label, left icon, country code selector (with flag and dial code), a text input area, right-side duration and link text, a right icon, and a helper text message below. Supports toggling visibility of icons, country code, link, helper text, and duration via boolean props.
enrichment.notes: The root wraps a label and the input container together, making a div with role=group appropriate. The actual interactive input is the inner 'Text Area' slot (e13). Consider using a native <input> or <textarea> inside e12. The helper text (e20) should be linked to the input via aria-describedby. The country code selector (e7) may need its own button/combobox role for accessibility.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A mobile text field component with optional country code selector, left icon, right icon, link action, and helper text. Supports phone number input with flag and dial code prefix.
enrichment.notes: The root wraps a label, an input container with country code picker, icons, and helper text. Use a native <input type='tel'> for the actual input element inside. The country code selector (flag + dial code + chevron) should be keyboard accessible. Helper text should be linked via aria-describedby to the input.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: Displays placeholder text within a form input or editable field, indicating the expected input to the user before any value is entered.
enrichment.notes: This component represents placeholder text typically rendered inside an input or textarea element. It should be used as a visual hint and is not interactive. Consider using the native HTML `placeholder` attribute on input elements instead of a separate component where possible.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A selectable option component for web interfaces, representing a single choice item that users can click or hover over. Typically used in dropdowns, menus, or selection lists.
enrichment.notes: The component name 'optionWeb' and its Default/Hover states suggest this is an interactive list option, likely used within a listbox or select-like UI. Consider wrapping multiple instances in a ul with role='listbox' on the parent container. If used inside a native select or listbox, role='option' on the button may be more appropriate than the default button role.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A dropdown selector component that allows users to open a menu and select an option. Supports multiple interaction states including default, hover, open, selected, error, locked, and disabled.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-expanded to reflect the open/closed state of the dropdown. When in 'Disabled' or 'Locked' state, set aria-disabled to true. Associate with a label element using aria-label or aria-labelledby for accessibility.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: Displays placeholder text for a mobile input or content area, indicating where user input or content is expected.
enrichment.notes: This component represents placeholder text, likely used within an input field or empty state on mobile. Consider using aria-hidden='true' if the placeholder is purely decorative or if the input already has a label.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A mobile option item that represents a selectable choice in a list or menu. Supports default and pressed states to indicate selection or interaction feedback.
enrichment.notes: This component is likely used within a mobile dropdown, select menu, or list of options. Consider wrapping multiple instances in a ul with role='listbox' on the parent container. The 'Pressed' state may indicate active selection, so aria-selected could be relevant depending on context.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A mobile dropdown component that allows users to select an option from a collapsible list. Supports multiple states including Default, Hover, Open, Filled, Error, Locked, and Disabled.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-expanded to reflect the Open/closed state. Set aria-disabled when in Disabled or Locked state. Associate with a visible label using aria-label or aria-labelledby. Consider pairing with a listbox role for the dropdown options panel.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A desktop dropdown form field component consisting of an optional label, a text input trigger that displays a dropdown options list, and optional helper text. Supports toggling visibility of the label, options panel, and helper text.
enrichment.notes: The root should be a div acting as a combobox container. The trigger input (e4) should be an <input> or <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the options list. The options list (e11) should be a <ul> with role='listbox' and each option a <li> with role='option'. Helper text should be linked via aria-describedby.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A mobile dropdown field component that displays a label, a text input trigger with an icon, an optional list of selectable options, and optional helper text. Supports toggling the options panel, label visibility, and helper text visibility.
enrichment.notes: The root should use role='combobox' with aria-expanded reflecting the Show Options state. The options list (e11) should be a ul with role='listbox'. Each optionMobile instance maps to a li with role='option'. The helper text container (e15) can be linked via aria-describedby.
